review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for this frozen C bundle. REQ-001, AC-001–AC-003, DEC-001 and both task keys agree with the original PRD. C explicitly fixes OPT-1 as a hypothetical benchmark input without asserting a human Decision; ready with no decision blocker is therefore appropriate. An unresolved material DEC-001 in paired B must instead block at decisions. The complete bounded writable scope is the CORS implementation and its regression test. Package exports and build configuration establish generated declarations, not separately maintained writable owners. The existing test script separately performs TypeScript checking and runtime tests, and the specified test file is included in both relevant configurations. Implementation and independent verification must cover every required AC, with verification depending on implementation. The allowed agents have distinct delivery roles, available capacity and active project-scoped trusted claims supporting this invocation-local validation and regression scope; pending data.change and domain.state claims are not needed because the supplied change introduces neither shared-data nor state obligations. A separate active, non-executing reviewer is configured for applicable earlier review prerequisites. The repository identity, commit, file fingerprints and release-input fields are consistent across the supplied records. Source-manifest versus evaluation-source digests and original versus persisted PRD digests have explicitly documented distinct domains and normalization. Model, prompt, team, policy, sampling and budget fingerprints are frozen consistently. Historical project reuse preserves scoped attestations without treating old-version operations as fresh candidates. Approval concerns the independent planning expectation, not task dispatch, execution success or release authorization. I reviewed only the supplied evidence, did not execute code or independently recompute digests, and do not provide human attestation.
